ops.text: On a Sprite, every drive verb relays to the coordinator's Mac as a blocking orca orchestration ask with a 600 s cap, and on Nov 13 each one (drive pr add, drive job set --repro, drive job report, a READ cci grep) sat pending for 10 to 40 minutes, so a builder re-resumes the same relay three or four times and cannot tell a slow Mac from a dead one; the relay's timeout message says only 'still pending', with no queue depth or age of the Mac's last answer.
